title: Abba, Father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A Babylonian of the first generation of Amoraim. He is mentioned in [Shabbat 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.56b.18), where Rav said: “There is none greater among penitents [than Yoshiyahu in his generation, and one] in our generation” — and who is it? “Abba, the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba; and some say Acha, the brother of Abba, the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba,” for the master said: Abba and Acha were brothers.[^1]
Hyman mentions him at Menachot 47b as “the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba taught.”[^2] His son Rabbi Yirmeyah was Rav’s student-colleague.

notes.text: The words in brackets complete the sentence from Shabbat. The text gives Abba and his brother Acha as alternatives for the penitent of Rav’s generation. The matching formula for Abba’s notice in Menachot remains unlocated.

The formula occurs in [Menachot 47a:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.47a.14). It introduces the dispute between Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Akiva over loaves that left the Temple courtyard before the blood of the offering was sprinkled. Hyman gives 47b.
